```{r sourcing, include=FALSE}
#source the R folder to load any packages and functions
lapply(dir('R', '*.R', full.names = TRUE), source)

#read in finalized data
dat <- readRDS("Output/Data/final_data.rds")

#subset for different analyses
control <- dat[food == 0] #just controls
food <- dat[food == 1|food == 0]  #just food add and control grids

#make a treatment+bucket
food[, treatment_food := paste0(treatment, "+", bucket)]
unique(food$treatment_food)

```


## Preliminary Analysis

Below is the results from the control model. This was a test to see the effects of litter size and local density on growth rates using control grids (KL and SU) only.

First, tested litter size and density as an interaction. Litter size was categorized into 4 categories but control grids didn't have the largest category.

```{r fig1, include = TRUE}

#this model is Growth Rate ~ Litter Size x Local Density
bmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density, control)
anova(bmod)

#get effects table
base_effs <- as.data.table(ggpredict(bmod, terms = c("littersize", "density")))

#plot results from model
ggplot()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group, fill = group), alpha = 0.2, data = base_effs)+
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, x = x, color = group, group = group), linewidth = 1, data = base_effs)+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Density (ind/ha)")+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Density (ind/ha)")+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", subtitle = "SU and KL only")+
  theme_bw()

```


Next, looked at the interacting effect of treatment on the grid level. This was either control, food add, or rattle. Did not account for bucket.

```{r fig2, include = TRUE}

#this model is Growth Rate ~ Litter Size x Density x Grid-level Treatment
gmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density*treatment, dat)
anova(gmod)

#get effects table
grid_effs <- as.data.table(ggpredict(gmod, terms = c("littersize", "density", "treatment")))

ggplot(grid_effs)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group, fill = group), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, x = x, color = group, group = group), linewidth = 1)+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Density (ind/ha)")+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Density (ind/ha)")+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", subtitle = "Grid Treatment")+
  facet_wrap(~facet)+
  theme_bw()

```

Next, incorporate bucket. Looking at only food add and control grids.


```{r fig 3, include = TRUE}

#make model for growth ~ litter size * food add
tbmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density*treatment_food, food)

#summaries
anova(tbmod)

#get effects table for model
tb_effs <- as.data.table(ggpredict(tbmod, terms = c("littersize", "density", "treatment_food")))

ggplot(tb_effs)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group, fill = group), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, x = x, color = group, group = group), linewidth = 1)+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Density (ind/ha)")+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Density (ind/ha)")+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", subtitle = "Grid Treatment + Bucket")+
  facet_wrap(~facet)+
  theme_bw()
  
```

```{r fig 4, include = TRUE}

#build off previous model, making it a mixed model with additional co variates 
tbmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density*treatment_food, food)

#this model is Growth Rate ~ Litter Size x Density x Grid-level Treatment
mixmod <- lmer(growthrate ~ 
              littersize*density*treatment_food +
              mother_age + 
              mother_age^2 +
              sex + 
              mast + 
              bjulian + 
              (1|mother_id/litter_id) +
              (1|year), 
            food)

#summaries
anova(mixmod)

#get effects table for model
mix_effs <- as.data.table(ggpredict(mixmod, terms = c("littersize", "density", "treatment_food")))

ggplot(mix_effs)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group, fill = group), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, x = x, color = group, group = group), linewidth = 1)+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Density (ind/ha)")+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Density (ind/ha)")+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", subtitle = "Grid Treatment + Bucket")+
  facet_wrap(~facet)+
  theme_bw()
  
```
